messages:
Anya: quick sync — following the postmortem, here's the condensed action list for DR/regional failover. planning a short game-day next Tue (0900 PT). add anything missing and claim owners.
Liam: adding network routing sanity checks to the list. i can own routing verification (two-step BGP/cidr checks + traffic steering smoke).
Priya: i'll take backups + restore runbook edits. need to update the S3 lifecycle snippet and add explicit restore timeline expectations.
Samir: i'll own the KV-cache warmup note and the canary traffic harness for the api gateway. estimate 3 days to land tests.
Anya: great. rough deadlines: routing verifications by Fri EOD, runbook edits by Mon EOD, canary harness by Mon EOD. if you need more time call it out now.
Liam: FYI — found a recurring pattern: regional routing flaps during scale spikes due to route preference mismatch. will add a pre-game checklist to force local-preference check.
Priya: backup note: last DR restore dryrun took 2.3 hrs (metadata verified) but token cache rebuild wasn't measured. adding a step to record KV warmup time.
Samir: canary harness plan: 1) route 5% to eu-west failover, 2) monitor tail latency and error rates, 3) cut back if error spike > 1%. will post PR with the test driver.
Anya: owners + tasks (short):
- Liam: multi-region routing sanity script, BGP route table diff, run before game-day. due: Fri EOD.
- Priya: restore_runbook.md updates (S3 retention, snapshot verification, measured restore timeline). due: Mon EOD.
- Samir: canary traffic harness + KV warmup measurement, integrate with console dashboards. due: Mon EOD.
- Anya: schedule game-day, coordinate oncall rotation, and write OOO fallback plan.
Liam: quick question — do we want an automated pre-check? i can add a cronjob to run route-diff and health probes 1h before the game-day.
Priya: yes please. also adding a small snippet to run during pre-check:
```
# verify latest snapshot exists and is accessible
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ --recursive | grep $(date -I)
# sanity restore to temporary namespace
kubectl -n staging exec -it restore-check -- /bin/sh -c "run-restore --snapshot latest --target /tmp/check"
```
Samir: thanks. i'll make the canary emit a persisted event so we can trace token warmup latency across services.
ops-bot: Reminder: game-day scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT. Please post final check-in 30m before start.
Anya: tagging the followups we'll track in the postmortem action board. please add estimated hours on each card so we can escalate if needed.
Liam: flagged a recurring incident pattern card: route-preference>scale, assigned to networking lead for long-term mitigation.
Priya: putting a note to include a rollback play in the runbook: steps to rehydrate caches from snapshot + traffic cutback commands.
Samir: small gotcha — caching layer requires a staggered reconnection to avoid thundering herd. i'll add a script to throttle client reconnects.
Anya: perfect. final ask: reply with ":thumbsup:" once you accept the owner + deadline. i'll compile and close the loop tomorrow.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup: planning to push runbook PR by Sun night.
Samir: :thumbsup: will open the canary PR today.
Anya: thanks team — see you on Tue. closing thread and moving action items to the tracker.
